# NFL Daily — 2026-08-04 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/04: Ravens WR Zay Flowers agrees to a four-year, $140M extension with $108M guaranteed, tying Justin Jefferson for the third-highest WR AAV at $35M/year. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49529316/zay-flowers-ravens-agree-four-year-140m-extension)
- 08/04: Falcons RB Bijan Robinson signs a three-year extension worth up to $75M, becoming the NFL's highest-paid running back. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49527923/falcons-rb-robinson-reach-3-year-deal-worth-75m)
- 08/04: Bears RT Darnell Wright agrees to a four-year, $116M extension with $93M guaranteed — the largest deal and highest guarantee ever for an offensive lineman. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49531184/sources-darnell-wright-agrees-4-year-116m-deal-bears)
- 08/04: Falcons EDGE Jalon Walker, a 2025 first-round pick, is feared to have torn his ACL after being carted off practice; MRI pending. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49531025/sources-falcons-jalon-walker-feared-torn-acl)
- 08/04: Packers pass rusher Micah Parsons says a Week 6 return against the Cowboys is "realistic" as he continues working back. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49531325/packers-micah-parsons-playing-vs-cowboys-week-6-realistic)
- 08/04: Dolphins CEO Tom Garfinkel is stepping down after 13 years; owner Stephen Ross elevates Daniel Sillman to oversee football operations. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2084665834455105911)
